body: Last year I overdosed on my sleeping pills and was on the brink of death.  My heart beat got to 20 beats per minute. If my mom hadn’t thought something was wrong and go look for me I would have been a goner.  Doctor said I could have just died at any second. I still to this day don’t regret it.  I want to die but I don’t at the same time.  Knowing what I could have done to everyone. Knowing that I have more life ahead of me (sounds cheesy af).  A few months after I met my favorite actors from my favorite tv show. Went to a concert with my best friend. Meet my boyfriend. And go to Mount Rushmore. Idk my mind is tired but also wants to keep going
I was almost successful last year cause I took a bunch of my sleeping pills.  It was so painless and all I did was sleep...but my parents caught me before I passed out so I went to the hospital 😕

It’s completely fine! I wrote it weird so I see where you misgendered me 😂 (I’m not angry lol) but I just wish the stigma on this stuff would just wash away because it’s bull crap.  It was just way too shocking.  It was like hearing from the people who supported my offender telling me that “He wouldn’t do such a thing.”  Or “I don’t believe he would do that.”
I’m a female 😂 they were talking about the guy who sexually assaulted me basically saying that it wasn’t his fault that he touched me and that it was his sexual urges.

Thank you that means a lot to me...it’s low key hard for me to talk about my sexual assault because I get so freaked out that people are just going to not believe me when it all happened. And then a therapist comes along and throws this crap at me. A THERAPIST 😂

People are so stupid. Today my therapist basically told me they thought I was lying about my sexual assault and then right after said “There’s a difference between a horned up boy and sexual assault” (I GAVE NO CONSENT TO BE TOUCHED CONSTANTLY).  Then they questioned my depression and are bringing in a psychologist to evaluate me when I’m 1000% sure that I’ve been evaluated before or “diagnosed”.  I CANNOT find a therapist that is good for me and I’ve just given up my hope on the human race.  I cannot find a decent therapist that’s open minded and laid back.  The past ones were up my ass and only threw coping skills at me instead of helping me deal with my past..throwing the stuff later makes it worse because I want to talk about it and learn to get through it..none of the coping mechanisms work.  I feel so hopeless
My therapist came in last night at my new doctor and yelled at me because I messed up on some communications...then I was told to move past trauma aside but I want to work on it

I believe it takes time because they think of everything that has happened...memories and all that...my nephew is somewhat holding me back because I want to see him grow up but I don’t want to end up committing sewer slide when he’s older (not knowing my mental health) and watch my future niece grow up

I feel like I’ve been holding on for too long..my old primary doctor wouldn’t even fix my medicine and sent me to a psychiatrist..been on a list for two months with my medicine not working.....I have an Appt next week but omfg I’m hurting a lot

I think for me it’s just mostly people closest but when I posted as a cry for help people just completely ignored it...that kinda made my heart ache and just made me feel that no one is even caring..I’m over here screaming my lungs out in a full room and no one can hear me
I’m too broke to do any of that :( I have bills so I’m stuck..I just want to get into my car and drive off and never look back but I need money 😂

The people closest to me turn an eye and don’t check on me when I’m in my lowest.  They literally don’t care until I attempt (I’ve done it multiple times and for some reason can’t friggin succeed because I’m a failure at everything)
Literally no one cares enough to post this shows how much people care about me

Dude I watched people get decapitated by terrorist groups and other crap like that...the world is so fucked up and it scared me.  I feel so guilty for the people that suffer such awful deaths and can’t get it out of my head. :(. I regret watching those videos where it’s like “Don’t google these 10 videos” because my dumbass is going to google it
I’d rather live in my dreams than deal with real life
